name: What should I do first if my house layout makes no sense anymore?

mainEntity.name: What should I do first if my house layout makes no sense anymore?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start by defining the daily problem the redesign must solve, then document the existing home accurately. For example, decide whether the priority is a larger kitchen, a shorter path to the bathroom, better separation between quiet and social areas, or space for an addition. A useful redesign depends on more than room names; household size, furniture, storage, hosting habits, accessibility needs, and future changes all affect the right arrangement. Key factors include existing dimensions, window and door locations, plumbing, electrical service, structural walls, ceiling heights, and the location of stairs or mechanical equipment. Gather a measured sketch, photos, utility information, and a list of must-haves before the consultation. Elite Remodeling & Design can then connect layout ideas with the construction implications for a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home remodel, addition, ADU, or garage conversion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Write down the specific problems your current layout creates, measure the rooms, and collect photos, plans, and utility information. Then compare redesign options against household needs, furniture, storage, structural walls, plumbing, windows, and future plans—not just appearance.
